title: PI plan — tranche 12 (retrospective, 2026-11-28)
body:
# PI plan — tranche 12

## Objectives

- **O1 — T15 is recorded through its closure.** The already-delivered tool authoring and BYO capability (PR #666, merge `a2ef9194eb2c`) gains the charter, baselines, WBS, registers, delivery contract, Phase-G review and closure review its record lacks; the nine non-authorisation packages clear and the manifest states the closed record.
- **O2 — T15's receipt is green on evidence.** The factory applies the pack on a fresh snapshot and T15 verifies green; the only package it cannot clear — `project_in_unauthorised_tranche:T15` — clears when #755 records the tranche-11 review.
- **O3 — the tranche exits on evidence.** The T15 receipt is fresh at one snapshot sha and `check-tranche-exit` writes a ready exit, so the tranche-12 review reads a measured tranche.

## Plan

One member, one pack. Readiness (four cadences, the PI documents, the plan approval and the retro lesson) is written first because the tranche-scope P1s `pi_cadence_missing:tranche-12` and `backlog_refinement_missing:tranche-12` are due the moment the tranche is authorised, and T15's `pi_cadence`, `pi_plan`, `pi_objectives` and `lessons` checks read it. The pack is preflighted offline at the pinned snapshot, then the factory runs after authorisation.

## WSJF order

| member | business value | time criticality | risk reduction | job size | WSJF |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T15 | 8 | 5 | 8 | 8 | 2.63 |

T15 is the only member. Its value is the programme's tool-authoring capability (B2); its time criticality is moderate because the capability is delivered and the debt is the record; its risk reduction is high because the effect ceiling and the BYO audit are the safety half of tooling; its job size is large because the authored set spans seven A–D artefacts, five registers, a contract, a Phase-G review and a closure.

## Capacity and WIP

- One live record writer: the replay record is shared with the tranche-7/8/9 lanes, so the tranche-12 rows are written by one session at a time and only at `period='tranche-12'`.
- One factory invocation: `rework-batch.py` is serial and refuses a dirty lane; the tranche-12 journal (`docs/evidence/rework/batch/tranche-12.jsonl`) is its single lock.
- WIP limits: two open batches and one open card per writer.
- Read agents: at most four, and no second full test suite on this box while a record write is in flight.

## Evidence

The pack is preflighted by `scripts/rework-content-check.py` at one pinned snapshot with the refinement WSJF and `closes=true`. The receipt is rendered by `scripts/verify-project.py` and the exit by `scripts/check-tranche-exit.py`; the readiness gate records the snapshot path, its sha and the checker result. The register this work answers is `docs/evidence/rework-register.json`, whose 10 open packages touch T15.

## Dependencies

- **#755** — the tranche-11 review is the only writer of tranche 12's authorisation; the dry run and every receipt wait for it.
- **T13, T6, P0** — T15's declared `depends_on`, all closed; no open construction edge remains.
- **#852** — the promotion lane has closed; this tranche writes only the replay copy.
- **#951/#952/#954** — the prepared lanes whose readiness shape is reused; no file ordering.

## Backlog refinement

The refinement re-estimates T15 by its open package count rather than its slice prose: 10 (1 P0, 2 P1, 7 P2). It records the four integers as the PI's re-estimate of record, which the batch reads before the pack is preflighted. The two tranche-scope packages are the refinement's own discharge: they clear when these rows and this record exist.
